title: PDF compressor: reduce PDF file size
description: Make a PDF small enough for email, online forms and upload limits: photos and scans inside are re-saved at a lower resolution, text stays text. Nothing is uploaded.

ui.imagesHint: Photos and scans inside the PDF are downsized and re-saved as JPG. Text, links and bookmarks stay as they are.
ui.scanHint: Every page becomes a single image. It helps when compressing images barely changed the size: images in uncommon formats, heavy drawings and diagrams. Text can no longer be selected or searched, and a regular text document usually only gets bigger this way.

level.label: Compression level
level.low: Low — {dpi} dpi, almost no quality loss

ui.noImages: The file has no images that can be re-saved: it was compressed only by cleaning up internal data.
ui.notSmaller: Couldn't make the file smaller: it's already well compressed. You'll get the original file unchanged. Try the “As a scan” method or the high level.
ui.notSmallerScan: As images, the file got bigger than it was. You can still download it — for example, so that text, a signature or a watermark can't be separated from the page. To make the file smaller, choose “Compress images”.
